cohort: Singleton live births (n=369,608) after fresh and frozen-thawed embryo transfers in Japan between 2007 and 2017
finding: Most cases of retained products of conception occurred after frozen-thawed embryo transfers, particularly in those using hormone replacement cycles.
mod_finding: Hormone replacement cycles and assisted hatching were significant risk factors for retained products of conception in vaginal deliveries, but not in cesarean sections.
